podcast.body: An alt-rock radio hit from 1996, featured on Nerf Herder's self-titled debut album. The song is described as self-referential and mundane, discussing everyday topics, aligning with the band's geeky ethos. "This is called Van Halen."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
